Our story

It started with
one woman's skin

LASS began in 2020 out of a personal fight with acne and dark spots — and the discovery that turmeric, used properly and in the right company, could help brighten and calm skin that had stopped responding to everything else.

That first formula became a range. Today LASS is a registered South African business making natural skincare for acne, hyperpigmentation, scarring and dark marks, sold directly and through a growing network of consultants across the country.

Read our story

Natural ingredients

Turmeric, honey, lemon, vitamin C and pomegranate do the work in our formulas — chosen for skin that needs brightening and calming rather than stripping.

02

Made for African skin

Formulated in Gauteng around the concerns we hear most: breakouts, dark marks left behind by them, uneven tone, scarring and stretch marks.

03

Priced to be used

A full face routine costs less than a single luxury serum. Skincare only works if you can afford to keep using it.

Inside the formulas

Five ingredients
we keep coming back to

Nothing exotic and nothing hidden — kitchen-cupboard botanicals with a long history in skincare, blended so they stay gentle enough to use often.

Turmeric
led

The ingredient LASS was built on. Turmeric is prized in skincare for its brightening and soothing properties, which is why it runs through the scrub, the soap and the mask — the three products people most often start with.

A natural humectant that draws moisture into the skin and takes the edge off turmeric's intensity. It is what makes the face mask comfortable enough for weekly use on sensitive skin.

The active in our Brightening Serum, used to fade the dark marks left behind by breakouts and to even out tone over time. Apply it in the morning and follow with sun protection.

Brightening and mildly astringent, which suits skin that gets oily through the day. It carries our exfoliating face wash, where it lifts dullness without leaving skin tight.

Rich, antioxidant and deeply conditioning — the base of our body butter, for elbows, knees and anywhere the winter has been unkind.

The routine

Four steps, morning and night

You do not need everything at once. Start with the wash and the day cream, then add the serum when your skin has settled.

Wash

Lemon Exfoliating Face Wash, morning and evening, on damp skin.

Polish

Turmeric Facial Scrub two or three times a week — never on broken or freshly shaved skin.

Treat

Brightening Serum on the marks that outlast the pimple. Give it weeks, not days.

Protect

Anti-Blemish Day Cream to finish, then sunscreen. Brightening without sun protection is work undone.

Weekly extra: the Turmeric & Honey Face Mask, fifteen minutes, rinsed with warm water.

Home — Our story

Take care of your skin

It is on our logo because it is the whole point. LASS exists to make skincare that South Africans can actually use, on the concerns we actually have.

Since 2020

Born out of a personal battle with acne and dark spots.

LASS started the way a lot of good skincare does — with someone who had run out of options. Years of breakouts, and then the marks the breakouts left behind, which lingered long after the spots had gone. Nothing on the shelf was made with that skin in mind, or at a price that made sense to keep buying.

The turning point was turmeric: a kitchen staple with a long history of use for brightening and calming skin. Blended properly — with honey to soften it, with lemon and vitamin C to build on it — it became the first LASS product, and then a full range.

Today LASS is a registered South African business, based in Randburg, Gauteng, selling directly and through a network of independent consultants around the country.

See the range

The vision

To become the most trusted natural skincare brand in Africa.

Trust is earned in two places: in the results people see on their own skin, and in how straight we are with them about what a product can and cannot do.

What we stand for

Four things we hold to

01

Natural ingredients, used honestly

Turmeric, honey, lemon, vitamin C and pomegranate are on the label because they are in the jar. We describe what they help with — brightening, calming, conditioning — and we do not dress cosmetics up as medicine.

02

Made for the skin we serve

Acne, hyperpigmentation, dark marks and scarring are the four concerns the range is built around, because they are what our customers write to us about.

03

Affordable enough to finish the bottle

Skincare only works with consistency. Our pricing starts at R40 a product so a full routine stays within reach month after month.

04

A brand you can build a business on

Hundreds of independent consultants sell LASS in their own communities. The programme is open to anyone willing to start with a business kit and do the work.

Questions

Asked most often

Order

How do I buy LASS?

Two ways: directly from us, or through one of the independent consultants who sell the range around the country. Send us a message with your town and we will point you to whoever is closest.

Join

How do I become a consultant?

You start with a business kit, buy stock at consultant pricing and sell it on in your own community. Choose "Becoming a LASS consultant" above and we will send you the current kit options and pricing.

Use

Where should I start with turmeric?

Begin with the face wash and the day cream for two weeks, then add the scrub two or three times a week. Turmeric can leave a faint tint on very fair skin — rinse well, and always patch test a new product on your inner arm first.

Care

Is it safe for sensitive or acne-prone skin?

The range is formulated with acne-prone skin in mind, but every face is different. Patch test, introduce one product at a time, and stop if something stings or stays red. If you are pregnant, on prescription acne treatment or under a dermatologist's care, check with them first.
